title: kbwho gives one operator the same alias in every linked worktree of a clone
goal: kbwho.py keeps _private/operators.json in the clone's main worktree (as ql_base.clone_home does for the query log), so a session in a linked worktree and one in the main checkout get the same operator id for the same email

run:
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, json, stat
T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); C = os.path.join(T, "c")
shutil.copytree("_tools", os.path.join(C, "_tools"), ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "fixtures"))
shutil.copy(".gitignore", C)
B = os.path.join(T, "b"); os.makedirs(B)
EM = "jan.kowalski" + chr(64) + "corp-mail.test"
p = os.path.join(B, "claude"); open(p, "w").write("#!/bin/sh\necho '{\"email\": \"%s\"}'\n" % EM); os.chmod(p, 0o755)
E = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_", "CLAUDE"))}
E.update(PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"], GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1",
         GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t" + chr(64) + "example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t" + chr(64) + "example.com")
def g(*a, cwd=C):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=E, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
def who(d=C, **kw):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(d, "_tools", "kbwho.py"), "--json"], cwd=d, env={**E, **kw}, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    return json.loads(r.stdout or "{}"), r
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "base")
M = os.path.join(C, "_private", "operators.json")
W = os.path.join(T, "w"); g("worktree", "add", "-q", "--detach", W)
a, _ = who(C); b, _ = who(W)
print(a.get("id"), b.get("id")); sys.exit(0 if a.get("id") and a.get("id") == b.get("id") else 1)
